page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Printed page number top right. Running head top centre. Marginal notes in the right margin: "Cap.2." and four quotation marks beside the lines of the lower text. Catchword "fitum" at right below the last line, signature "F 3" at left below the text.

main_text.p: confequeretur abfurdum nempe fubftan-ftantialem corporis formam effe corpus. At spiritu noftri corporis effe corpus profitentur, omnes tum Philofophi, tum Medici.Id utique teftatur Ariftoteles libro de Spiritu: Et hac ratione demonftrari poteft.Cap.2. Quicquid em loco mouet, id corpus eft naturale. At omnis fpiritus noftri corporis loco mouetur. Propterea Hippocrates libro fexto Epidimiōn, Sectione feptima,fpiritus intus permeantia, & impelletia uocat. Propterea omnis noftri corporis fpiritus eft corpus.Adde quod quicquid alitur, augeturq;,aut minuitur,id uerum & naturale eft corpus.Spiritum autem noftri corporis aere ab arteriis attracto,& alimenti concoctione, humoribusq; ali, & augeri: contrà uero horum penuria,ipfum minui, ac marcefcere: aut prorfus extingui docent Ariftoteles,Galenus & quotidiana experientia. Quod demum fpiritus corporis fit corpus haud negat ipfe Fernelius, qui libro de Spiritu & innato calido fpiritum, in hunc modum definit.Eft(inquit)fpiritus aethereum corpus,caloru,« facultatumq; fedes & vinculum,primumq; obeundæ functionis instrumetum.« Errat igitur Fernelius dum in-«fitum

page.notes: Printed "Ethacratione" is run together in the scan; read as "Et hac ratione". "em" (enim) has an unclear abbreviation mark. "Epidimiōn" has a superscript mark over the n, read as a macron. The printed text runs on from "in-" to the catchword "fitum"; the catchword is kept as printed. The four quotation marks in the right margin stand beside the lines "corpus,caloru", "culum", "ftrumetum" and "Errat"; they are reproduced as printed.
